title: Repeat Restart Charge on Professional Services Projects Remobilization
content:
**Professional Services Projects — engagements restarted more than once.**

1000.00 is added to the remobilization fee when two or more remobilization fees were posted on the engagement in the twelve months before the invoice date, 500.00 when exactly one was, and nothing otherwise, a fee counting when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posted date from the invoice date. A whole month is complete only on the same day number of a later month.

| Remobilization fees posted on the engagement in the twelve months | Added |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1000.00 |
| exactly one | 500.00 |
| none | nothing |

Hypothetical illustration: one remobilization fee posted five months before the invoice date and another posted thirteen whole months before it leave one fee in the window, adding 500.00.
